source_caption:
Zoe Saldaña made her film debut in Center Stage, playing Eva Rodriguez with the kind of confidence and edge that instantly stands out. Before becoming a global sci-fi icon, she trained as a dancer herself, which made Eva’s frustration, discipline, and physical presence feel genuinely lived-in.

Center Stage (2000), directed by Nicholas Hytner, starring Amanda Schull, Zoe Saldaña, Susan May Pratt. A passionate dance drama about young ballet students chasing perfection, rivalry, and identity inside the high-pressure world of a prestigious New York academy.

source_details.title: Center Stage
source_details.synopsis: Center Stage is a 2000 American teen drama film directed by Nicholas Hytner about a group of young ballet dancers from various backgrounds who enroll at the fictitious American Ballet Academy in New York City. The film explores the issues and difficulties in the world of professional dance, and how each individual copes with the stresses. It also served as the film debut for actresses Zoe Saldaña and Amanda Schull. The film was released theatrically in the United States on May 12, 2000. The single from the film's soundtrack "I Wanna Be with You" is performed by Mandy Moore.
